command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; set +e so a failure reaches the line that reports it (spawn#707).
echo "78f2179b25983313d5450876236f92b58c10d0845d62b7a832329e32c871cad1  airway_1.30.0.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c || { echo "FAIL: airway_1.30.0.tar.gz does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
echo "5495aa368924b367c26d9c4ccd79e2a100193bb94f36ad5d15e79e6c170673c7  deseq2.R" | sha256sum -c || { echo "FAIL: deseq2.R does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
nproc | awk '{print "nproc\t"$1}'; uname -m
T0=$EPOCHREALTIME
Rscript deseq2.R > deseq2.log 2>&1
RC=$?
T1=$EPOCHREALTIME
cat deseq2.log
awk -v a="$T0" -v b="$T1" 'BEGIN{printf "wall_s\t%.2f\n", b-a}' | tee -a report.tsv
test -s report.tsv || { echo "FAIL: no report"; exit 1; }
exit $RC
